== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[A Power Loss (ALT)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[A Power Loss (ALT) (Errata)]] shares the [[A Power Loss (ALT)]] column.
